label: Text 1
transcript: Eli is saving for a second-hand bicycle. Naima is saving for a one-week language course in Dublin. They are both keeping notebooks. Eli's is a small green ledger; Naima's is a sticky note that has migrated five times in two months. Mr. Yilmaz, who has watched this, says: "How you keep the record is part of the discipline."
